"""Proposed inert controls for fixed controller classification and pre-resume/final-publication checks.

No Python startup/import/compile/test, native execution, model construction or child transport is performed.
All proposed cases exercise the changed reverse dependency and actual factory path using inert lower services.
"""
from dataclasses import replace
import unittest

import asr_loading_adapter as adapter
import trusted_asr_resolver as resolver
import durable_lifecycle as durable
import snapshot_lifecycle as lifecycle
from snapshot_lifecycle import Phase, SessionClosed, LifecycleUnavailable
from controller_boundary_fixture import ControllerBoundaryFixture, StopAtControllerSeam


class ControllerBoundaryContracts(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_actual_controller_startup_sequence_order_and_lock_ownership(self):
        f = ControllerBoundaryFixture()
        with f:
            with f.published() as (startup, session, worker):
                self.assertIs(type(startup), adapter._ControllerASRStart)
                self.assertIs(type(session), lifecycle.OwnedSession)
                self.assertIs(session._worker, worker)
                self.assertIs(session._record.phase, Phase.NATIVE_RUNNING)
                token = f.manager._token(startup.permit.record.key)
                self.assertEqual(token.phase, "WORKER_BOUND")
                self.assertTrue(token.resume_attempted)
                self.assertIs(token.worker, worker)
                self.assertIs(f.manager._kernel._starts.get(startup.permit.identity), worker)

                expected_order = ["delegate_create_suspended", "controller_consumed", "delegate_resume", "delegate_finish_start"]
                self.assertEqual(f.seam_events, expected_order)

                self.assertFalse(f.lock_states["create_manager_locked"])
                self.assertTrue(f.lock_states["resume_manager_locked"])
                self.assertTrue(f.lock_states["resume_token_locked"])
                self.assertFalse(f.lock_states["finish_manager_locked"])
                self.assertFalse(f.lock_states["finish_token_locked"])

    def test_selection_or_value_change_before_resume_stops_worker_without_resume(self):
        f = ControllerBoundaryFixture()
        with f:
            def mutate_selection_before_resume(startup, session, worker):
                custody = f.custody(startup)
                f.profile = replace(f.profile, profile_id="altered-profile-id")
                adapter.RUNTIME_PROFILE = f.profile

            f.on_created = mutate_selection_before_resume
            with self.assertRaises(adapter.AdapterUnavailable):
                with f.scope() as startup:
                    f.factory.open_owned_session(startup, startup.permit)

            self.assertNotIn("delegate_resume", f.seam_events)
            self.assertEqual(f.f.events.count("stop_exact"), 1)
            token = next(iter(f.manager._tokens.values()))
            self.assertEqual(token.phase, "QUARANTINED")
            self.assertTrue(token.revoked)

    def test_token_record_worker_substitution_before_resume_refuses(self):
        for mode in ("substitute_worker", "substitute_token_worker", "substitute_owner"):
            with self.subTest(mode=mode):
                f = ControllerBoundaryFixture()
                with f:
                    def substitute_before_resume(startup, session, worker):
                        token = f.manager._token(startup.permit.record.key)
                        if mode == "substitute_worker":
                            f.manager._kernel._starts[startup.permit.identity] = object()
                        elif mode == "substitute_token_worker":
                            token.worker = object()
                        elif mode == "substitute_owner":
                            startup.permit.record.owner = object()

                    f.on_created = substitute_before_resume
                    with self.assertRaises((adapter.AdapterUnavailable, lifecycle.LifecycleUnavailable, SessionClosed)):
                        with f.scope() as startup:
                            f.factory.open_owned_session(startup, startup.permit)

                    self.assertNotIn("delegate_resume", f.seam_events)
                    self.assertEqual(f.f.events.count("stop_exact"), 1)

    def test_revocation_or_lease_exit_at_either_boundary_preserves_first_error(self):
        for boundary in ("before_resume", "before_publication"):
            for fail_cleanup in (False, True):
                with self.subTest(boundary=boundary, fail_cleanup=fail_cleanup):
                    f = ControllerBoundaryFixture()
                    with f:
                        if fail_cleanup:
                            f.f.sync_action = lambda: (_ for _ in ()).throw(RuntimeError("secondary_sync_failure"))

                        if boundary == "before_resume":
                            def revoke_before_resume(startup, session, worker):
                                session._revoked = True
                            f.on_created = revoke_before_resume
                            expected_exc = SessionClosed
                        else:
                            def revoke_before_publication(worker, permit_id, startup):
                                record = next(iter(f.manager._records.values()))
                                record.owner._revoked = True
                            f.on_finish = revoke_before_publication
                            expected_exc = SessionClosed

                        with self.assertRaises(expected_exc) as caught:
                            with f.scope() as startup:
                                f.factory.open_owned_session(startup, startup.permit)

                        self.assertEqual(f.f.events.count("stop_exact"), 1)
                        record = next(iter(f.manager._records.values()))
                        self.assertIs(record.phase, Phase.QUARANTINED)
                        self.assertIsNone(record.owner._worker)
                        if fail_cleanup:
                            self.assertTrue(caught.exception.__notes__)

    def test_classification_refuses_foreign_subclassed_or_unissued_controller_without_generated_fallback(self):
        f = ControllerBoundaryFixture()
        with f:
            with f.scope() as startup:
                class SubclassedController(adapter._ControllerASRStart):
                    pass
                subclassed = SubclassedController(
                    startup.release, startup.approval, startup.manifest, startup.admission,
                    startup.selected, startup.policy, startup.usage, startup.binding, startup.permit
                )
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(adapter.AdapterUnavailable, "subclasses and foreign"):
                    f.factory.open_owned_session(subclassed, startup.permit)

                unissued = adapter._ControllerASRStart(
                    startup.release, startup.approval, startup.manifest, startup.admission,
                    startup.selected, startup.policy, startup.usage, startup.binding, startup.permit
                )
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(adapter.AdapterUnavailable, "without issuance"):
                    f.factory.open_owned_session(unissued, startup.permit)

                fake_profile = {"controller": True, "choice": "large"}
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(adapter.AdapterUnavailable, "Replaced profile"):
                    f.factory.open_owned_session(fake_profile, startup.permit)

            self.assertEqual(f.seam_events, [])
